additional_info.subject: Status: QA9-10 Feedback stuck at OFF
0467606 - ID0467606-DC/Si-D/CH-[MP / S0 170004175] CP1 Issue CRM:00472000482
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
After our call this morning I saw a charging session in this charger. Outlet 2 was charging and Outlet 1 was OoO.
I look at the logs and the issue is the same as in the ticket ID0457595. Feedback from contactors QA9-10 are missing. When this happen during the charger session the logic is to set the other outlet out of order to prevent any short-circuit between outlet 1 and 2.
From what I understood you have already replaced the contactors. So my guess here the problem is a loose connection from the feedback line or for the 24V that supply the contactors.
Bellow are the necessary measuring point to track this issue. Could be necessary to force 24V in QA37 to look for the fault. I will assign the ticket back to you but in case you need support for the intervention, send me a TEAMS invitation.
In the logs we confirm the issue here:
